## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] I tested the change on Windows or performed an appropriate non-destructive validation.
- [ ] I ran `tests/Static.Tests.ps1`.
- [ ] I updated documentation where behaviour changed.
- [ ] I did not commit secrets, logs, machine-specific state or personal data.

## Tweak safety checklist

Complete this section for any system tweak:

- [ ] Detection is defined.
- [ ] Original state is captured before modification.
- [ ] Apply is verifiable.
- [ ] Undo restores the original state rather than an assumed default.
- [ ] Undo is verifiable.
- [ ] Risk, compatibility, reboot requirements and known side effects are documented.

## Evidence

Add relevant Windows build(s), screenshots, logs with sensitive data removed, or technical references.
